headline: When is my soulmate coming?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why. This is a SELF-FRAME hook, so the hopeful yes is affirmed with certainty; the DATE stays banned. The art line and the bridge are unchanged.

Face-UP decks only — arcana-mfh (Magician/Hanged Man/Fool) and arcana-eef (Emperor/Empress/Fool), so she CHOSE the card rather than turned it, and two card-sets means two sets of copy. The Fool copy is shared between them, verb already correct.

⭐ THESE ARE THE ONLY TWO HOOKS ON THE FUNNEL THAT READ HER RATHER THAN HIM. SELF_FRAME_HOOKS swaps 'tendency, never a verdict' for 'affirm the hopeful yes with certainty' — which is safe here precisely because no specific man exists to be convicted or acquitted. So these are warmer than everything else in this batch, on purpose.

⚠️ SEED FAMILY WITH NO GUARD FILE (`tests/tarot-self-frame-copy.test.ts` does not exist) — only the generic guards apply. 🔴 Still never tie it to one named person and 🔴 never give a date. cards-soulmate's tendency permits the 'when' to be answered only as a LEANING, never as a timeframe.

Finding: the 'when' is answered only as a LEANING — close, closer than the fear admits — and never as a date. What gets certified with real warmth is that she has not been waiting on nothing.

a: You chose the Magician, dear. Look — his right hand holds a white rod straight at the sky.
You asked when your soulmate is coming. Your hand went to the man who makes things happen.
So yes, dear. Something is on its way to being made.
And his hand is up, dear, because a thing is being made now.
But no date from me, dear. Nobody honest would give one.
That's why the wait has felt so long, dear. No one gave you a marker.
Let me look closer at what still stands in the way…
b: You chose the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the tree he hangs in is still green and alive.
You asked when your soulmate is coming. Your hand went to the card of a last stretch.
So you're on the last stretch, dear. Not the whole road.
And the tree is still green, dear, right through the hanging.
But a pause isn't a stop, dear, and you have been in one.
That's why believing through it took so much, dear. It wasn't silly.
Let me look closer at what has been holding this pause open…
c: You chose the Fool, dear. Look — he's walking into open air with his chin up.
You asked when your soulmate is coming. Your hand went to the one who steps first.
So something begins here, dear. That is what this card is.
And he's already moving, dear, before he can see the end of it.
But no date, dear, and no name. That part isn't mine to give.
That's why the road looks empty, dear. You are already on it.
Let me look closer at what's standing on that road…

a: You chose the Emperor, dear. Look — he holds a gold ball in his left hand.
You asked when your soulmate is coming. Your hand went to the man who builds to last.
So what you're holding out for is solid, dear. It does exist.
And the gold in his hand is weighty, dear, and meant to keep.
But you've turned down things that wouldn't have lasted, dear.
That's why it has taken this long, dear. You knew your own worth.
Let me look closer at what still sits between you and it…
b: You chose the Empress, dear. Look — twelve stars in the crown on her head.
You asked when your soulmate is coming. Your hand went to the warmest woman in the deck.
So this card is full, dear. There's nothing empty in it.
And her crown has twelve stars, dear, and every one is lit.
But you've held the door open a long time, dear. That costs.
That's why waiting wears you, dear. The holding is the heavy part.
Let me look closer at what has been sitting in that doorway…
c: You chose the Fool, dear. Look — he's walking into open air with his chin up.
You asked when your soulmate is coming. Your hand went to the one who steps first.
So something begins here, dear. That is what this card is.
And he's already moving, dear, before he can see the end of it.
But no date, dear, and no name. That part isn't mine to give.
That's why the road looks empty, dear. You are already on it.
Let me look closer at what's standing on that road…
